patch_description: The current best (1035.14) routes only on the cost-valid view and ignores None-cost edges entirely; Gen 2 (1021.03) showed that k-shortest candidates plus shared-edge reuse across partitions lowers cost. This edit combines both insights safely: (1) compute a baseline path on the cost-valid subgraph via Dijkstra, (2) compute an alternative path on the full graph where None-cost edges are given the median observed edge cost as a neutral default — never a huge penalty — and (3) adopt the alternative only if its strictly-evaluated valid-graph cost is lower, preserving the "never worse than baseline" invariant. Edge reuse across partitions is tracked in `shared_edges` so already-paid edges cost ~0 when scoring subsequent destinations, reducing redundant transfers across the broadcast.
